choice: scripts/dock-setup.sh starts the helper with `cmux new-surface --placement dock --pane <page pane>` as a background tab of the page's pane; the helper titles its tab 'Linear server' with an OSC escape; a resume binding lets cmux restart it after a relaunch once the user approves Auto-Restore.
context: The helper asks the cmux CLI which workspace is selected. With the default automation.socketControlMode cmuxOnly, cmux answers only processes started inside its terminals.
rejected: A launchd agent with socket mode `automation` (any process of the user could drive cmux; the user called a system service overkill); socket mode `password` (unverified effect on agent hooks in cmux terminals); reading cmux's session-restore file instead of the socket (undocumented format); the first layout, with the terminal as a visible Dock section above the page (the user disliked the extra window).
title: Run the helper in a Dock terminal tab hidden behind the page
